parameters.formDescription: Leave blank to use the sample, or fill in your own.

parameters.text: ={{ 'Check prerequisites. Topics: ' + $json.topics + ' at ' + $json.level + ' level. Identify exactly 2 prerequisite topics, each as a yes/no question. Return ONLY strict JSON, no markdown. Schema: {prerequisites:[{topic:string, question:string}]}. Exactly 2.' }}

parameters.completionMessage: Designing your syllabus. You'll get an approval email shortly.

parameters.text: ={{ 'You are an expert curriculum designer. Think step by step and question yourself. Now: ' + $now.toISO() + '. Topics requested: ' + $('Parse Prerequisite Answers').first().json.topics + '. Level: ' + $('Parse Prerequisite Answers').first().json.level + '. Deadline: ' + $('Parse Prerequisite Answers').first().json.deadline + '. What the student already knows: ' + $('Parse Prerequisite Answers').first().json.prereqSummary + '. Decide: (1) if vague, expand into a concrete syllabus of specific subtopics, one by one; (2) for each subtopic estimate how many focused study sessions it needs at this level; (3) make sure there are ENOUGH total sessions for the level (school ~4, high school ~4-5, undergraduate at least 5-6, postgraduate ~6-7, expert/professional at least 7-8) and EVERY subtopic is covered at least once even when time is short; (4) judge whether it fits before the deadline. Return ONLY strict JSON, no markdown. Schema: {plausible:boolean, reason:string, goal:string, thoughts:string, syllabus:[{topic:string, detail:string, sessions:number, reason:string}]}. thoughts = brief self-reasoning. If not plausible, syllabus empty. Mark false only for truly absurd targets like mastering quantum mechanics at undergraduate level in 5 minutes.' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Approve your study schedule: ' + $json.goal }}

parameters.text: ={{ 'The student DECLINED the proposed schedule. Their reason: ' + ($('Propose Plan & Wait Approval').first().json.data['Reason (if declining)'] || 'no reason given') + '. The previous syllabus/schedule was:\n' + $('Parse & Schedule').first().json.planText + '\nRevise the syllabus to directly address that reason (fewer or more subtopics, fewer or more sessions per subtopic, reorder, lighter pace). Keep it feasible before the deadline. If the user suggests a time period within which to fit your sessions, strictly follow the user preferences. Deadline: ' + $('Parse & Schedule').first().json.deadline + '. Return ONLY strict JSON, no markdown, same schema: {plausible:boolean, reason:string, goal:string, thoughts:string, syllabus:[{topic:string, detail:string, sessions:number, reason:string}]}. plausible must be true.' }}

parameters.jsCode:
const s=$('Parse & Schedule').first().json;
return s.parts.map(p=>({json:{ requestId:s.requestId, session:p.session, topic:p.topic, detail:p.detail, content:p.content, reason:p.reason, slotStart:p.slotStart, slotEnd:p.slotEnd, status:'scheduled' }}));

const parts=$('Expand Parts').all().map(i=>i.json);
return [{ json:{ status:'scheduled', sessions:parts.length, requestId:$('Parse & Schedule').first().json.requestId, message:parts.length+' sessions scheduled to your calendar and sheet, each with a reason. Done.' } }];
